_about: Extras: colors the Themes need that tokens/colors_and_type.css does not define.
A value is a literal oklch(), a DS token (--color-ink-900, resolved in the Variant's scope) or night.<name>.
night = the DS Terminal kit palette (ui_kits/terminal/Terminal.jsx, constant T). Dark only.
ansi.dark: Terminal kit colors + off-brand blue/cyan at matched lightness/chroma.
ansi.light: hue + chroma of the DS -700 tokens (red=error, green=success, yellow=warning, magenta=pink), lightness raised to the lightest value still >= 4.6:1 on --bg-surface.
Brights not listed here are derived: Dark L+6, Light L-6. Zed dim slots: Dark L-10, Light L+10.
relevel: DS tokens whose value fails the Contrast gate as text on --bg-surface. Same hue + chroma, lightness moved to the nearest value >= 4.6:1. Applies to every Target.
